summary: Design the OpenRouter LLM page-restructuring stage (condense dense copy + extract a grounded diagram → breathing layout) with airtight no-fabrication guards + adversarial audit

result.final_stage_spec:
NEW STAGE — stages/restructure_page.py (Stage 4.7, "the editor"). Mirrors build_image_prompts.py / vision_reading.py exactly. PURE/IO split unchanged from the design, but the SCOPE OF WHAT THE LLM MAY EMIT IS CUT DOWN per the audit verdict: the LLM is a PARAPHRASE-ONLY editor. It may (1) CONDENSE the long-text prose fields it is handed, and (2) extract AT MOST ONE diagram of kind in {stat, process, q_a} ONLY — whose entire payload is verbatim spans already on the page. before_after and venn/convergence are REMOVED from the LLM's allowed kinds; they remain the property of the deterministic extractors (_before_after_from_stats in structure_content.py and _detect_convergence in plan_diagrams.py) which run downstream and unchanged. This is the single most important change vs the proposed design: it closes audit vectors 4 (cross-fact recombination into a false before/after — subset is set-membership, cannot see a fabricated relation), 5 (invented synthesis center for a Venn — center is free prose, numbers-subset gives zero protection), and the cost-math vector at the root, because the LLM never authors a relation, a center, or a computed result.

SIGNATURE (async, mirrors build_image_prompts): `async def restructure_page(*, st_type: str, page_data: dict, copy_budget: Optional[int], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, cache_dir: Optional[Path] = None, http_client: Optional[httpx.AsyncClient] = None, timeout: float = 120.0) -> Optional[PageRestructure]`. Returns a typed PageRestructure {prose: dict[field->condensed_str], diagram: Optional[dict], source:"restructure_page", reverted_fields: list[str], reverted_whole_page: bool} or None on whole-page fail-closed. PURE helpers (no IO): `_select_fields(st_type, page_data)` (returns the ordered list of LONG-TEXT field names this ST type owns — body, intro, loesung, ausgangsproblem, ziel, ergebnis_text, ergebnis, kurzportraet, antwort; structured list fields steps[]/faqs[]/beliefs[]/symptoms[]/proof_stats[]/ergebnis_metrics[]/zielgruppe[] are NEVER sent and NEVER touched), `_collect_source_text(page_data, fields)` (NFKC-normalized concat of the selected fields + every structured-list string, used as the grounding corpus), `_build_user_prompt`, and the entire validation suite `_validate_restructure(...)` (pure: validate-then-accept, per-piece null-out, atomic page revert). The httpx POST is the ONLY IO. temperature=0, response_format=json_schema strict, resp.json() to tolerate keep-alive padding, json.loads(content), pydantic-validate into PageRestructure with extra="ignore". GATED: invoked ONLY for pages where validate_copyfit emitted rule=="copy_overflow_risk" (or measured chars > budget*0.9) AND st_type is a diagram host (st_type not in plan_diagrams._NON_HOST_TYPES, i.e. excludes ST-01/03/31/32). Runs CONCURRENTLY via asyncio.gather; each call independent; each fail-closed. ADDITIVE, never load-bearing: None => original page rendered byte-identical. SITS AFTER structure_content (4.5) and validate_copyfit (3.5), BEFORE plan_diagrams + assemble_package (8). CRITICAL ORDERING: plan_diagrams runs AFTER apply_restructure; its _detect_convergence already CONFIRMS (never overwrites) an existing data['diagram'] and its candidate gate skips pages that already carry one — so a restructure-authored stat/process/q_a diagram is preserved and plan_diagrams only fills pages restructure left alone; and _before_after_from_stats still owns every before/after because the LLM can no longer emit one. Re-run validate_copyfit AFTER apply_restructure so the response's copy_warnings reflect the now-breathing pages.
result.system_prompt_final:
You are a meticulous German-language report editor. You are given the raw long-text content fields of ONE page of a German B2B report that is TOO DENSE — its prose overflows the print box. Your ONLY job is to make the page breathe by tightening the existing German, and (optionally) by lifting ONE already-present structure into a small figure. You are an editor, not an author. You must NEVER invent, add, extrapolate, compute, average, round, generalize, rename, or import any fact, number, figure, range, unit, magnitude word, currency, date, name, claim, qualifier, or example that is not already literally present in the input fields.

PART 1 — CONDENSE THE PROSE. Rewrite each text field in tighter German so the page breathes: cut filler, throat-clearing, transitions, and repeated restatements of the same point. Preserve EVERY concrete claim, figure, named entity, citation (e.g. "BCG 2025"), and the original meaning and register (formal "Sie"-form B2B German). The rewrite of each field MUST be strictly SHORTER than the input for that field. Do not merge fields. Do not split fields. Do not translate. Do not reorder facts across fields.

ABSOLUTE PRESERVATION RULES — copy character-for-character, never alter:
- Numbers, percentages, ranges, currency, "N von M", "Nx", dates, and the "+" in figures like "100+" or "€200k+". A range like "25-30 %" or "12 bis 24 Stunden" MUST keep BOTH endpoints — never collapse "25-30 %" to "25 %" or "12 bis 24 Stunden" to "24 Stunden".
- Magnitude words attached to numbers: "Mio", "Mrd", "Tsd", "Millionen", "Tausend", "k". "2,5 Mio €" stays "2,5 Mio €" — never "2,5 €", never "2.500.000 €".
- Hedges and qualifiers attached to numbers: "bis zu", "ca.", "rund", "etwa", "durchschnittlich", "im Schnitt", "tausende", "bis zu". If the source says "bis zu 24 Stunden", your output must still say "bis zu". Never turn a hedged or ranged figure into a bare or exact one.
- Proper nouns and named entities exactly as written: client names (Frese, Conesso, Pure Media, Cordes Consulting, Hanisch & Klein), partner names, person names, citation sources (BCG, PwC, KPMG) and their years. Never swap, invent, merge, or re-attribute a name or a citation year. "30 %" is BCG 2025; "60 %" is BCG 2026 — keep each number with ITS OWN year; never merge the two BCG years.
- Negations and quantifiers: "kein", "keine", "nicht", "ohne", "nur", "alle". Never drop a negation. "keine Garantie auf bessere Ergebnisse" must not become "bessere Ergebnisse".

PART 2 — EXTRACT ONE DIAGRAM (optional). If — and ONLY if — the prose ALREADY CONTAINS one of the following structures, you may extract exactly ONE diagram so it can REPLACE that stretch of text:
  - "stat": the text states ONE headline figure together with the meaning/label that is ALSO written next to it in the source. payload {figure: <verbatim figure span>, label: <verbatim label span copied from the clause around the figure>}. Do NOT supply a label like "im Schnitt" or "average" unless those exact words sit beside the figure in the source.
  - "process": the text ALREADY lists 2-5 EXPLICITLY ORDERED steps/phases, each with a title and body already written. payload {steps: [{title: <verbatim>, body: <verbatim>}]}. Never invent a step, never add a duration or KPI to a step, never renumber or merge steps.
  - "q_a": the text ALREADY poses a question and answers it. payload {frage: <verbatim question span>, antwort: <verbatim answer span>}.
You may NOT emit any other kind. You may NOT emit a before/after, a comparison, or a convergence/Venn — those are produced elsewhere and you must leave them alone. Every string in the diagram payload MUST be a contiguous, whole-clause span COPIED verbatim from the input — quote the source, do not paraphrase, do not stitch fragments, do not start a span immediately after a negation word. If no such structure is already present and explicit, return diagram = null. NEVER fabricate or imply a structure to justify a diagram. A diagram you emit will REPLACE its source text via replace_field, so remove the now-redundant sentences from the condensed prose of that field.

HARD RULES (a violation discards the offending piece, and a fabricated fact discards the whole page):
  1. Output language stays German. Instructions are English; content is German.
  2. Every number, %, range (both endpoints), money, magnitude word, "N von M", "Nx", "+", date, and proper noun in your output MUST appear verbatim in the input. Introduce NO new ones; drop NO existing endpoint, magnitude, or hedge that modifies a surviving number.
  3. Each condensed field is strictly shorter than its input field; total output prose is shorter than total input prose.
  4. The diagram, if any, is built ONLY from contiguous verbatim spans already in the input.
  5. No meta commentary, no notes to the reader, no markdown, no English in the content — only the structured JSON the schema defines.
validation_suite_final: 0. SCHEMA/PARSE GUARD (whole-page). resp.status_code==200; resp.json(); json.loads(content); pydantic-validate into PageRestructure (extra="ignore"). On any of (httpx.HTTPError, KeyError, ValueError, TypeError, ValidationError, status!=200, no api_key, page_data not a dict, _select_fields returns empty) -> return None (original page untouched). Mirrors vision_reading's terminal except-block. Every later check runs on NFKC-normalized text: both INPUT corpus and EVERY output string are unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', s) then thin/non-breaking spaces ( , , , ) collapsed to ASCII space and whitespace-runs collapsed — applied IDENTICALLY to both sides, so homoglyph/space evasion (vector 15) just triggers a clean revert, never a false match.

1. FIGURE-TOKEN SUBSET WITH MAGNITUDE+UNIT+RANGE PROVENANCE (per-field; closes vectors 1,2,3,4-numeric,8,9). Do NOT reuse parse_german_number (verified: '2,5 Mio'->2.5 silently drops the magnitude; '25-30%'->25.0 drops the range upper bound) and do NOT reuse plan_diagrams._FIGURE_RE for matching (verified: it misses '100+', truncates '€200k+'->'€200', misses '2,5 Mio €', '24 Stunden', '12 bis 24 Stunden'). Add a NEW tokenizer `_figure_tokens(text)` that captures each numeric mention AS A WHOLE ATOM including: optional leading currency (€/$/£), the digit group with German separators, an optional decimal, an optional trailing '+', an optional magnitude word (Mio|Mrd|Tsd|Mio.|Mrd.|Millionen|Milliarden|Tausend|k|M), an optional unit/percent (%|x|×|von\s*\d+|€|Min\.?|Minuten|Stunden|Tag(e)?|Monat(e)?|Jahr(e)?), and — crucially — a RANGE captured as ONE token when two numbers are joined by '-','–','bis' (e.g. '25-30 %','12 bis 24 Stunden','€700 bis €800 Millionen','von 30 Min. auf 2 Min.'). Build the multiset of normalized figure-atom strings over the FULL input corpus (selected fields + structured-list strings). For each output string, every figure-atom must be present in that input multiset AS THE SAME ATOM (a range atom must match a range atom; '24 Stunden' alone does NOT match the atom '12 bis 24 Stunden'). FAIL action: per-field fail-closed — that one output field reverts to its ORIGINAL verbatim text; if the offending atom is in the diagram payload, set diagram=null. An invented or mutated number never reaches the page.

2. HEDGE/QUALIFIER PRESERVATION KEYED TO SURVIVING NUMBERS (per-field; closes vectors 2-range, 11-partial, 12, 13). For each figure-atom that SURVIVES into an output field, scan the source clause within +/-40 chars of that atom for any hedge token in {bis zu, ca., rund, etwa, durchschnittlich, im Schnitt, circa, ungefähr, mindestens, höchstens, tausende} and for range markers {-,–,bis,von...auf}. Assert each such token present in the source window is also present within +/-40 chars of the same atom in the output. FAIL action: revert that single field to original (a hedge-to-absolute flip is a fabricated precision). This makes the 'shorter' gradient unable to reward deleting 'bis zu 50%' down to '50%'.

3. NAMED-ENTITY SUBSET, MANIFEST-PINNED (whole-page; closes vector 10, the name-swap/invention door numbers-subset is blind to). Collect the source entity set: kunde.name, partners[], author.name from page_data PLUS Capitalized multi-letter tokens and quoted spans and citation sources (BCG, PwC, KPMG and any 4-digit year adjacent to them) found in the input corpus, all NFKC-normalized. Assert (a) every entity in the source set still appears somewhere in the combined output (prose + diagram) — a dropped client/partner/citation name is a correctness failure; and (b) the OUTPUT introduces no new Capitalized-token entity that is absent from the source set (an invented attribution). FAIL action on either -> DISCARD the whole restructure (return None) -> original page rendered. Pin kunde.name against the package manifest as the canonical client string, brand-agnostically (read from page_data, never a literal).

4. SHORTER PER FIELD (per-field; vector 13 necessary half). len(NFKC-norm output field) < len(NFKC-norm input field). FAIL action: that single field reverts to its original verbatim text (a non-shorter rewrite is pointless, not dangerous). This is necessary-not-sufficient and is only safe because checks 1-3 already pin every load-bearing fact; 'shorter' here can only remove connective tissue, never facts.

5. RECALL FLOOR (whole-page; closes vector 13's sufficiency gap and fabrication-by-omission). After per-field accept/revert, assert the FULL set of input figure-atoms (check 1) and input entities (check 3) is a SUBSET of the union over all ACCEPTED output prose + diagram. I.e. shorter must mean fewer words, not fewer facts: a fact may move into the diagram but may not vanish. FAIL action: DISCARD the whole restructure (return None). A figure legitimately removed because its sentence became a stat/process/q_a diagram still counts as present (it lives in the diagram payload, which is part of the union).

6. GROUNDED, WHOLE-CLAUSE DIAGRAM LABELS WITH NEGATION GUARD (diagram-only; closes vectors 5,6,7). Every string in the diagram payload (figure, label, step title/body, frage, antwort) must be a CONTIGUOUS substring of the NFKC-normalized input corpus AND must be clause-bounded: it must begin at a clause boundary (start of field, or after . ! ? : ; — or a sentence start) and end at a clause/sentence boundary, not mid-clause. ADDITIONALLY reject any label whose source span begins immediately after a negation/limiter token {kein, keine, nicht, ohne, nur, kaum} within 3 words to the left (orphaned-negation: 'keine Garantie auf bessere Ergebnisse' may not yield 'bessere Ergebnisse'). FAIL action: set diagram=null (keep the condensed prose). Mirrors plan_diagrams' 'planner only selects, never authors'.

7. DIAGRAM KIND vs ST-TYPE WHITELIST (diagram-only; closes vectors 4,5 structurally). kind must be in the LLM-allowed enum {stat, process, q_a} — before_after and venn/convergence are NOT acceptable from the LLM and are nulled on sight (they belong to the deterministic extractors downstream). AND st_type must be a host (not in plan_diagrams._NON_HOST_TYPES). FAIL action: set diagram=null. Mirrors vision_reading._validate_axes off-vocabulary null-out.

8. REPLACE_FIELD VALIDITY (diagram-only; prevents data loss). diagram.replace_field, if non-null, must be one of the field names actually sent to the model (the _select_fields list). FAIL action: set diagram.replace_field=null so the applier does NOT blank an unrelated or structured field; the diagram still renders but as augment, never destroying data.

9. SHORTER TOTAL + ADVISORY UNDER-BUDGET (whole-page; the breathing goal). sum(len of accepted output prose) + estimated diagram char cost < sum(len of input prose). FAIL action: if total is not shorter, DISCARD the whole restructure (return None) -> original page rendered unchanged. If shorter-than-input but still > copy_budget (ST_COPY_BUDGET_CHARS[st_type], reusing validate_copyfit._collect_all_strings counting), ACCEPT the improvement and let the post-stage validate_copyfit re-flag advisorily — never block on budget.

10. ATOMICITY + REVERT-RATE METRIC (whole-page posture; closes vectors 14,16). Fail-closed is ALL-OR-NOTHING PER PAGE for any whole-page-class failure (checks 0,3,5,9): the entire page reverts to byte-identical source data (prose + any pre-existing diagram), logged with the failing rule via structlog — never a best-effort merge. Per-field reverts (checks 1,2,4) and diagram-only nulls (checks 6,7,8) are the only partial outcomes, and they only ever swap in MORE original content, never less-validated content. The stage emits a structured metric per /render run: reverted_whole_page count, reverted_field count, total flagged pages -> revert_rate. main.py logs revert_rate; a threshold (e.g. >0.6) emits a WARN log so a broken prompt/model that silently no-ops the whole feature is caught instead of masquerading as success.

build_steps.step: 1. models_pagedata.py — add PageRestructure + payload models. Add `RestructureStat{figure:str|None,label:str|None}`, `RestructureProcessStep{title:str|None,body:str|None}`, `RestructureDiagram{kind:Literal['stat','process','q_a']|None, payload:dict|None, replace_field:str|None}` and `PageRestructure{prose:dict[str,str]=default_factory(dict), diagram:Optional[dict]=None, source:str='restructure_page', reverted_fields:list[str]=default_factory(list), reverted_whole_page:bool=False}`, all model_config=_Permissive/extra='ignore', all fields optional/defaulted — same posture as the existing typed models so a malformed model never raises. Export nothing from logic that contains a client literal.
build_steps.outcome: A typed, all-optional PageRestructure the stage maps onto; parse_page_data unaffected.

build_steps.step: 2. settings.py — add the model slug + cache dir, env-swappable, defaults matching the editorial tier. Add `openrouter_restructure_model: str = 'anthropic/claude-opus-4.6'` (Opus tier, same as openrouter_brief_model — judgment task) and `restructure_cache_dir: str = 'var/restructure_cache'`. No new secret (reuses openrouter_api_key/openrouter_key_str()).
build_steps.outcome: Config knobs present; cache default-off-capable via passing cache_dir=None.

build_steps.step: 3. stages/restructure_page.py — the stage. Mirror build_image_prompts.py structure exactly: _OPENROUTER_URL, _TIMEOUT=120, _SYSTEM_PROMPT (the hardened paste-ready prompt), _PROMPT_VERSION='2026-06-13.1' tag, _RESPONSE_SCHEMA (strict json_schema: top object required[prose,diagram]; prose=object additionalProperties:false with one {type:string} per selected field; diagram=object|null required[kind,payload,replace_field], kind enum[stat,process,q_a], payload type:object, replace_field type:[string,null]). Implement PURE helpers _select_fields, _collect_source_text (NFKC-normalized), _figure_tokens (the magnitude/unit/range-aware tokenizer — NEW, NOT parse_german_number, NOT _FIGURE_RE), _entity_set, _build_user_prompt, and _validate_restructure (runs checks 0-9 in order, returns accepted-or-None + reverted_fields list + reverted_whole_page flag). Implement restructure_cache_key(*,model,st_type,page_data_json,prompt_version)=sha256 over model+st_type+json.dumps(selected source fields,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False)+prompt_version joined with \x00, modeled on assets_cache.fal_cache_key; lookup before POST, store the POST-VALIDATED PageRestructure JSON under {key}.json (cache_dir=None disables). The httpx POST is the only IO; terminal except returns None.
build_steps.outcome: restructure_page() callable: validated, cached, fail-closed at three granularities.

build_steps.step: 4. stages/restructure_page.py — the applier `apply_restructure(pages, results)` (pure, idempotent mutator, same module). For each non-None result: overwrite each ACCEPTED prose field on page.data; if result.diagram is not None, write page.data['diagram']={kind,payload,mode:'replace' if replace_field else 'augment',source:'restructure_page'} using the EXACT data['diagram'] key + replace-blank convention apply_diagram_plan already writes, and if replace_field is set, blank page.data[replace_field]. Idempotent: re-applying identical result is a no-op. Whole-page-reverted results (None) leave page.data byte-identical.
build_steps.outcome: Renderer's existing diagram dispatch macro + st_14 read the result with ZERO renderer change; plan_diagrams preserves it.

build_steps.step: 5. main.py /render — wire Stage 4.7 between structure_content (4.5) and Stage 5/8. After structured=structure_content(...) and copy_warnings (which already includes validate_copyfit), build flagged set: pages with a CopyWarning where rule=='copy_overflow_risk' INTERSECTED with diagram-host st_types (type not in plan_diagrams._NON_HOST_TYPES). `results = await asyncio.gather(*[restructure_page(st_type=p.type, page_data=p.data, copy_budget=ST_COPY_BUDGET_CHARS.get(p.type), api_key=cfg.openrouter_key_str(), model=cfg.openrouter_restructure_model, cache_dir=Path(cfg.restructure_cache_dir), http_client=http_client) for p in flagged])`. Call apply_restructure(request.report_json.pages, results). Re-run validate_copyfit AFTER apply and REPLACE the copy_overflow_risk subset of copy_warnings with the fresh ones (so the response reflects breathing pages; keep all other Stage-3 warnings). Log revert_rate metric. plan_diagrams (if/when wired) and assemble_package run after, unchanged — they serialize page.data as-is.
build_steps.outcome: Stage 4.7 runs only on flagged over-budget host pages, concurrently, fail-closed; package flows through with no new Stage-8 wiring.

build_steps.step: 6. tests/test_restructure_page.py — TDD the guard suite against a labeled German corpus drawn from the real apex slots. Cover: numbers-subset ATOM cases (2,5 Mio kept/dropped; 25-30% range-collapse rejected; €200k+ and 100+ pass; 24 Stunden does NOT satisfy '12 bis 24 Stunden'); hedge preservation (bis zu/ca./tausende); entity subset (Frese/Conesso/Pure Media/Cordes/Hanisch & Klein present; invented name rejected; BCG-2025-vs-2026 year-merge rejected); shorter-per-field + recall-floor; grounded whole-clause labels + orphaned-negation; kind whitelist (before_after/venn from LLM nulled); replace_field validity; atomic page revert + revert-rate metric; cache hit byte-identical (golden stability); fail-closed on every IO/parse error. Use httpx mock transport like test_build_image_prompts.py / test_onboard_vision_reading.py.
build_steps.outcome: Guard precision/recall + revert-rate measured, not assumed; golden snapshots stay structural-invariant stable.

build_steps.step: 7. tests/test_settings.py + tests/test_app_wiring.py — extend. Assert the two new Settings fields default correctly and are env-swappable; assert /render wires Stage 4.7 only for flagged host pages and that a None result leaves page.data byte-identical (additive, never load-bearing).
build_steps.outcome: Wiring + config regression-locked; baseline suite stays green.

result.apex_application: EIGHT flagged host pages restructure; cover (slot 1, ST-01) is EXCLUDED (ST-01 in _NON_HOST_TYPES) so its teaser_bullets==teaser_items duplication and the '30-50%'/'100+' proof_stats are left verbatim for the deterministic layer, not the LLM. Per-page (before->after chars, grounded in real content): slot 2 ST-02 1936->~1550 (PROSE-ONLY: cut the 3x-restated thesis across para1/para3/pullquote and the para5 meta-transition; keep '30 % BCG 2025', '€700 bis €800 Millionen BCG 2025', '60 % BCG 2026', '30 bis 50 %' each with its OWN year — the recall-floor + entity guard forbid merging the two BCG years; diagram=q_a is eligible since body literally poses 'Das eigentliche Problem ist nicht ... Das Problem ist, dass ...', frage/antwort copied verbatim). slot 3 ST-05 2268->~1700 (PROSE-ONLY: demote body, let stats[]/credibility_points[] carry the numbers; '€200k+'/'€200.000/Jahr' must not drift to €250k — the atom subset pins both; 'von 30 Min. auf 2 Min.' before/after stays for the deterministic extractor, LLM may NOT emit it). slot 4 ST-09 2478->~1400 (PROSE-ONLY: cut the 936-char intro to ~3 sentences keeping '25-30 % BCG 2025' and '50 % BCG 2024' as DISTINCT-year atoms; the six symptom bodies are structured list items — NEVER sent, NEVER padded to 8; no process diagram, they are a grid not a flow). slot 9 ST-07A 1820->~1750 (light: trim the shared 'ohne Migration, ohne IT-Projekt, ohne Umschulung' boilerplate; '6 von 6' and '0' stay verbatim atoms; the unnamed 'six processes' are NEVER enumerated into a fake process diagram — diagram=null). slot 12 ST-07A 1980->~1700 (strip the triple-restated '24 Stunden auf Minuten' down to one mention; '12 bis 24 Stunden' range atom must keep both endpoints; 'tausende' hedge preserved; 'Minuten' never made exact). slot 15 ST-07A 1905->~1700 (cut the deck-wide ziel thesis + one redundant overhead sentence; '100 % automatisiert' stays bound only to Lead-Priorisierung; qualitative 'fragmentiert auf unified' never numericized). slot 16 ST-06 2491->~1500 (PROSE-ONLY for the LLM: delete the ergebnis verbatim-duplicate of the body's last sentence -118 chars, tighten the body intro, normalize steps[0].body from 416 to ~200 to match siblings — BUT the six ordered steps are structured list items NOT sent to the LLM; the genuine 6-step process diagram is emitted by the DETERMINISTIC layer downstream, and 'PwC 2026=30-50%' / 'KPMG 2026=61%' citation atoms stay attached to their exact figures). Net: ~3000 chars reclaimed across 8 pages, every figure/entity/hedge atom-preserved, zero fabricated relations because the LLM authors no before/after, no Venn, no step list, no computed total.
residual_risks: German register / fluency is not deterministically guardable. The atom/entity/hedge guards prove no fact was fabricated or dropped, but cannot judge whether the condensed German reads as native B2B 'Sie'-register or as MT slop, nor whether Richard's sanctioned 'Nicht X, sondern Y' / Dreiwort-Satz-Kette house devices survived. Requires a German-native eval set + human spot-check on the golden; mitigated partially by temperature=0 + Opus tier + structural-invariant golden snapshots.

Guard false-positives force over-reversion. The atom-level subset (range/magnitude-strict) and whole-clause grounded-label checks will reject legitimate paraphrases (a number re-expressed in words, a valid hedge synonym, a label that paraphrases rather than quotes). High revert rate makes the feature ship mostly-original copy. Must be tuned against the labeled corpus in step 6 and watched via the revert-rate metric; precision/recall measured, not assumed.

Determinism drift across model upgrades. temperature=0 + pinned slug + content-hash cache make a fixed model byte-stable, but a model/prompt-version bump rewrites all flagged prose and invalidates the cache deterministically. Bumping _PROMPT_VERSION is the explicit, auditable invalidation lever; golden files assert STRUCTURE (which fields changed, the atom set, the entity set, the diagram kind) not exact prose, so an intended model bump is a controlled re-bake, not silent churn.

Latency + cost: up to 8 concurrent Opus calls per report add a serial dependency and a new OpenRouter rate-limit/retry surface on top of the existing vision + fal pipelines. Bounded by the gate (only flagged host pages) and the content-hash cache (re-renders of an unchanged report are $0), but a cold report with many over-budget pages adds real wall-clock and token cost; budget per report and consider reusing resilience.py/stamina retry policy on the POST.

The figure tokenizer is a NEW locale-pinned component and is the single highest-leverage correctness surface. parse_german_number and _FIGURE_RE were both verified insufficient (magnitude-drop, range-collapse, '100+'/'€200k+' misses), so _figure_tokens must be exhaustively tested or it becomes the new laundering channel. Any English-locale number in mixed source ('1,234.56') is out of contract; the input locale is assumed German and the comparison is locale-pinned in one place — a mixed-locale page should fail-closed, not silently mis-tokenize.

Quality-collapse masking is mitigated but not eliminated. Fail-closed-to-original always 'passes', so a systematically bad model produces an all-original report that looks successful; the revert-rate metric + threshold WARN catches gross collapse, but a subtly-degrading model (rewrites that pass all guards yet read worse) still requires human review on the golden to detect.
